first_step_test: A low tapered paper wrapper with a gently curved top rim gives a beginner a stable base for the frosting and cherry.

source.notes: First cupcake sheet rejected because its peaked frosting contour disappeared under a cherry. Second six-cell sheet had wrapper scale drift in its first cell; selected its five stable later cells, then cropped them as a new raster contact sheet without changing their art.

final_elements.name: paper wrapper
final_elements.description: One low tapered cupcake wrapper with a curved top rim and flat bottom.

final_elements.name: frosting dome
final_elements.description: One frosting mound attached to the wrapper rim, with a top-center gap reserved for the cherry.

final_elements.name: cherry
final_elements.description: One round cherry touching the peak of the frosting mound.

final_elements.name: cherry stem
final_elements.description: One short bent stem emerging from the top of the cherry.

final_elements.name: wrapper pleats
final_elements.description: Four vertical pleat lines spaced across the wrapper front.

final_elements.name: frosting sprinkles
final_elements.description: Five short separate sprinkles spaced across the frosting.

final_elements.name: broken ground shadow
final_elements.description: One short broken shadow under the wrapper.

frames.visible_job: Outline a low paper wrapper and attached scalloped frosting, leaving an open gap at the top center for the cherry.
frames.instruction: Draw a low tapered wrapper with a shallow curved rim. From both rim ends, curl uneven frosting scallops upward, stopping short of the top center to leave a round gap for the cherry.

frames.visible_job: Add one round cherry into the reserved frosting gap and a short bent stem.
frames.instruction: Fill the reserved top-center gap with a round cherry, joining its lower sides to the two frosting curves. Add one short bent stem above it; keep every earlier line.

frames.visible_job: Draw four separate vertical pleat lines within the established wrapper.
frames.instruction: Inside the wrapper, pull four short pleat lines from the curved rim toward the flat bottom. Space them unevenly and keep them inside the outline.

frames.visible_job: Add five short sprinkles on the frosting and a broken shadow under the wrapper.
frames.instruction: Scatter five short separate sprinkle strokes over the frosting, avoiding the cherry. Beneath the wrapper, draw a short broken ground shadow.

final_step.visible_job: Fill established frosting pink, cherry red, and wrapper teal with streaky felt-tip marker.
final_step.instruction: Fill the established frosting with streaky raspberry pink, the cherry red, and the wrapper teal. Keep five black sprinkles and four black pleats visible inside the color.

visual_review.first_step_observation: The first saved crop shows a low tapered wrapper and two scalloped frosting sides, with a clean circular opening at the top for the later cherry.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: Five saved square states preserve the wrapper rim, frosting scallops and reserved top gap; cherry, four pleats, five sprinkles and three broken ground marks appear before color. No temporary guides or unexplained contour loss.

transitions.observed_addition: The wrapper rim and scalloped frosting sides remain in place; one round cherry fills their reserved top gap and a bent stem rises above it.
transitions.instruction_match: The cherry instruction matches the circle and attached stem; no peak line has to be erased.

transitions.observed_addition: The wrapper, frosting, cherry and stem remain; four uneven vertical pleat lines appear inside the lower paper cup.
transitions.instruction_match: The wrapper instruction matches exactly four new interior pleats.

transitions.observed_addition: The four pleats and upper forms remain; five dash sprinkles appear on the frosting and three separate shadow marks below the wrapper.
transitions.instruction_match: The sprinkle and ground instruction matches the five new dashes and three broken marks.

transitions.observed_addition: All prior contours, four pleats, five sprinkles and three ground marks remain as pink, red and teal streaky marker fill is added.
transitions.instruction_match: The final instruction matches color on established contours with no new structural form.
